entries.description: A shadcn/ui-style component library for generating PDFs in React using @react-pdf/renderer. Copy-paste components (table, card, badge, section, document), a Tailwind-style tw() resolver, and pre-built block templates (invoices, salary slips, reports). Install via the shadcn CLI.
